## Windows: unsigned release

<!-- Remove this section once Windows releases are code-signed. -->

This Windows build is **not code-signed**:

- **SmartScreen** may show "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
- **Windows 11 Smart App Control** in enforcement mode may block the installer outright. Workaround: turn Smart App Control off (Windows Security → App & browser control → Smart App Control settings; it can't be turned back on without resetting Windows), or wait for a signed release.

Windows 11 x64 only. A crashed background service is not restarted automatically on Windows; it shows as unhealthy in the app and can be restarted with one click.
